jobs: Dawn over a small medieval village of thatched cottages. A young villager in a simple brown tunic carries a bundle of firewood on his shoulder and has stopped walking, looking at the distant hills, where two war banners are rising, a red one on the left hill and a blue one on the right hill. Soft mist, sunrise. Wide landscape framing.

Illustrated storybook painting, hand-painted gouache and watercolour with soft brush texture and warm golden light, medieval Europe, rich colours, cinematic composition, like a classic children's history book illustration. No text, no letters, no logo.

A wide low view across a green field as two medieval armies charge into each other from left and right, red banners against blue banners, knights on horses, spearmen, dust and flying turf. In the near foreground at the edge, the same young villager in a brown tunic crouches behind a low stone wall, small and frightened. Wide landscape framing.

Close behind the young villager in a brown tunic as he runs and ducks through the middle of a medieval battle, soldiers fighting on both sides of him, a horse rearing past, a splintered shield on the ground, arrows stuck in the earth at his feet. Dynamic, tense, at his eye level. Wide landscape framing.

Quiet moment in the smoke of a battlefield: the young villager in a brown tunic kneels beside a fallen knight in armour lying on the grass, the knight's gauntlet resting open beside a long sword and a torn golden banner. A single beam of sunlight breaks through the smoke onto the sword. Solemn, still. Wide landscape framing.

The young villager, now standing tall on a hilltop holding a raised sword high, a golden banner beside him, an army of his own gathering behind him, and in the valley below a town with a stone castle and many houses glowing in the sunset. Triumphant, epic, heroic. Wide landscape framing.
